facts.text: Kelley was platted in 1875 by Joseph Kelley after the Des Moines to Minneapolis railroad came through his farm, later called the Chicago‑Northwestern.
The city was named after George Kelley, one of the town's earliest residents.
Kelley’s core values emphasize small‑town character, guided growth, and preservation of historical, cultural, and natural heritage.
A Kelley post office opened in 1875 and operated until 2013, marking over a century of local mail service.
Kelley sits within Story County, Iowa, and is part of the Ames Metropolitan Statistical Area, linking it to the larger Des Moines–West Des Moines–Ames region.
